hooks.name: Translation Sync
hooks.description: When a GUI source with i18n() calls is saved, checks that it is listed in po/POTFILES.in and that no Rust-only \u{...} escape crept into a translatable literal. Runs as a command and stays silent unless something needs a decision; only adding a POTFILES line is left to the agent. Previously an `agent` action, which made the model run the same three greps by hand after every .rs save in rustconn/src.
